data.body_html:
Combine the thrill of wild dolphin sightings with a leisurely Spanish brunch on a private charter from Puerto Banús. The Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2034 is a 2-hour morning experience aboard the Astondoa 40, a 12.5-metre motor yacht that takes up to 9 guests. Departing at 10:00, you'll cruise the Costa del Sol coastline, spot dolphins, and enjoy a spread of cured meats, cheeses, pastries, and cava — all included in the flat €749 price. No per-person fees, no hidden extras. Just you, your group, and the Mediterranean.

Why choose the 2034 morning dolphin watching brunch cruise

Most dolphin watching trips in Marbella are group tours with 20+ strangers. This is a private charter — your party only. The Astondoa 40 is a 12.5m flybridge with plenty of shade and sunbathing space, a bathroom, and a sound system. The skipper handles all navigation and spotting, so you can relax with a glass of cava and watch for fins breaking the surface. The 2-hour window is ideal: early enough to beat the heat and the afternoon wind, but late enough to enjoy a proper brunch.

Dolphin species you can expect to see

The waters off Marbella are home to two main species. The striped dolphin (Stenella coeruleoalba) is the most common, often seen in pods of 10–50. Bottlenose dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) appear in smaller groups, usually 5–15. Our skippers know the feeding grounds near Cabopino, Cala del Faro, and the mouth of the Río Verde. Sightings are successful 85–90% of the year. If you don't see any, we'll rebook you for free.

What's included in the €749 charter price

The price covers the entire boat for up to 9 guests. No per-person charges. Included:

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for 2 hours of cruising
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)
  • Brunch: cured meats, local cheeses, bread, olives, fruit, pastries
  • Drinks: cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, water

There is no extra charge for the brunch or drinks. Everything is set out on the flybridge table when you board.

Itinerary: 10:00 to 12:15 from Puerto Banús

Meet at the Astondoa 40 in Puerto Banús (berth assigned upon booking). Board at 09:45. Depart at 10:00. Cruise west toward Cabopino, then east toward Cala Cortés. The skipper adjusts the route based on dolphin activity. Brunch is served around 10:30. Return to port by 12:15. You'll have the rest of the day free to explore Marbella's Golden Mile or relax on the beach.

How to book your Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2034

Reserve via WhatsApp or our online booking form. A 50% deposit secures the date; the balance is due on the day. We recommend booking at least 72 hours in advance, especially from June to September. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. For more options, browse our full fleet of charter boats in Marbella.

Frequently asked questions

What time does the Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise depart?

The cruise departs at 10:00 from Puerto Banús. Arrive 15 minutes early for boarding. The total experience lasts about 2 hours, returning by 12:15.

How many people can join the dolphin watching brunch cruise?

The Astondoa 40 accommodates up to 9 guests. The private charter is priced at €749 for the entire boat, so you can split the cost among your group.

What is included in the brunch?

The brunch features a selection of Spanish cured meats, local cheeses, fresh bread, seasonal fruit, pastries, and unlimited cava, beer, white wine, soft drinks, and water. All food and drink are included in the price.

Are dolphins guaranteed on the cruise?

We guarantee a dolphin sighting or you can rebook for free. Our skippers know the best spots off Cabopino and Cala del Faro. Sightings are successful 85–90% of the time, with common dolphins and bottlenose dolphins most frequent.

What should I bring on the dolphin watching cruise?

Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, a light jacket or windbreaker, and a camera. The morning sun on the water can be strong, and a breeze often picks up. All food and drink are provided.

Can I book the cruise for a special occasion?

Absolutely. The private charter is ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, or proposals. Let us know in advance, and we can arrange a cake or extra decorations at no extra cost.

What is the cancellation policy?

Free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. Within 48 hours, the full amount is charged unless we can resell the slot. Weather-related cancellations are fully refunded or rebooked.

Is the dolphin watching brunch cruise suitable for children?

Yes, children are welcome. The Astondoa 40 has safety equipment for all ages, and the brunch includes kid-friendly options like bread, fruit, and soft drinks. Life jackets are available for children.
